title: RSTGCN: Railway-centric Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network for Train Delay Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2510.01262v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate prediction of train delays is critical for efficient railway operations. While earlier approaches have largely focused on forecasting the exact delays of individual trains, studies on station-level delay prediction are somewhat sparse. To address this gap, we propose the Railway-centric Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network (RSTGCN), designed to forecast average arrival delays of all the incoming trains at a particular station for a particular time period. Our approach incorporates several architectural innovations and novel feature integrations, including train frequency-aware spatial attention, which significantly enhance predictive performance. To support this effort, we curate and release a comprehensive dataset for the entire Indian Railway Network (IRN), spanning 4,735 stations across 17 zones - the largest and most diverse railway network studied to date. translated_title: RSTGCN：面向铁路延误预测的以铁路为中心的时空图卷积网络
translated_abstract: 准确预测列车延误对于高效铁路运营至关重要。早期方法主要关注预测单列列车的精确延误，而针对车站级别的延误预测研究相对较少。为填补这一空白，我们提出了以铁路为中心的时空图卷积网络（RSTGCN），旨在预测特定车站在特定时间段内所有进站列车的平均到达延误。我们的方法融入了多项架构创新和新颖的特征集成，包括列车频率感知的空间注意力机制，这显著提升了预测性能。为支持这项工作，我们整理并发布了一个覆盖整个印度铁路网络（IRN）的综合数据集，涵盖17个区域的4735个车站——这是迄今为止研究的最庞大且最多样化的铁路网络。我们使用多个标准进行了广泛实验。
tldr: 本文提出RSTGCN模型，通过列车频率感知空间注意力等创新，实现了车站级别列车平均延误预测，并发布了覆盖印度全境4735个车站的最大规模铁路数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the RSTGCN model, which uses innovations like train frequency-aware spatial attention to predict station-level average train delays, and releases the largest railway dataset covering 4,735 stations across the Indian Railway Network.
